content.text: Eight years: "נשאר בידיים" 63,726, I put in "הפקדתם" 48,000. Four years: the page just says there's no calculation for self-employed before 6 years. I'm done.

input.answer: If I put in 500 ₪ a month, the calculator says I'd have about 63,700 ₪ "נשאר בידיים" after 8 years (I'd have paid in 48,000). For 4 years it gives me no number: it says there's no calculation for self-employed people who take the money out before 6 years.

stuck.why: There's a big 25,725 at the top right, so at first I thought that was my money. Then I read the label under the dashed box, 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך', and saw it's the other option, not the fund.
Reading from the right, the first big number is 55,471 (the securities account). The fund's number, 63,726, is the next one along. Easy to mix them up.

used: Orange note 'לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים'
Bars labelled הפקדתם 48,000 and נשאר בידיים 63,726
skimmed: Intro text 'מה זה' about 6 years and tax
skipped: כדאי להכיר גם / במה אפשר להשקיע chips
Fields תשואה בשנה and דמי ניהול בשנה (left as they were)
unsure_meaning: הכנסה חייבת בחודש: I just put my salary
dotted purple underline under the numbers
not_found: Any number for taking the money out after 4 years as a self-employed person

findings.what: At 4 years there's no number for the fund, only an orange note. The only big number on the screen is 25,725, and it belongs to the other option, so it's easy to grab it by mistake.
The rightmost bar, which is the first thing I read, is the comparison account (55,471). The fund's own total sits next to it.
Labels under the bars get cut off at the bottom of the screen, e.g. 'אחרי דמי...' and 'ניירות...'
The chart shows empty dashed boxes for years 1–5 and doesn't say why next to them
